_documentation._instructions: Copy this file to config.json (which is gitignored) and fill in your credentials. NEVER commit config.json to version control.
_documentation.tenant_id: Your Azure Active Directory (Entra ID) tenant ID. Found in Azure Portal > Azure Active Directory > Overview > Tenant ID.
_documentation.client_id: The Application (client) ID of the app registration in Azure AD that has been granted access to the Business Central API. Found in Azure Portal > App registrations > your app > Overview.
_documentation.client_secret: A client secret generated for the above app registration. Found in Azure Portal > App registrations > your app > Certificates & secrets > Client secrets. NOTE: The secret value is only shown once when created.
_documentation.environment: The Business Central environment name (e.g. production, sandbox). Found in Business Central Admin Center > Environments.
_documentation.company_id: The GUID of the company within Business Central you want to target. Find it by calling GET https://api.businesscentral.dynamics.com/v2.0/{tenant_id}/{environment}/api/v2.0/companies or in Business Central under Settings > Company Information.
_documentation._app_registration_setup: Ask your admin to: (1) Register an application in Azure AD (Entra ID). (2) Under API permissions, add Dynamics 365 Business Central > Application permissions > API.ReadWrite.All. (3) Grant admin consent. (4) Create a client secret under Certificates & secrets. (5) Share the Tenant ID, Client ID, Client Secret, Environment, and Company ID.
